mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GESTURE_THREAD_POST_COMMENT (postNo, threadNo, comment, commentWriter) VALUES (${postNo}, ${threadNo}, #{comment}, #{commentWriter})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.threadNo, a.postNo, a.commentNo, REPLACE(a.comment, '\n', '
') AS comment, a.commentWriter, IFNULL(b.userNm, '') AS commentWriterNm, DATE_FORMAT(a.regDate, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS commentRegDate, FN_GET_BEFORE_TIME_SIMPLE(IFNULL(a.modDate, a.regDate), #{countryCd}) AS commentAgoTime, IF(IFNULL(modDate, FALSE) = FALSE, FALSE, TRUE) commentIsUpdate FROM GESTURE_THREAD_POST_COMMENT AS a LEFT JOIN GESTURE_FORUM_USER AS b ON a.commentWriter = b.ccode WHERE threadNo = ${threadNo} AND postNo = ${postNo} AND isRemove = 0 ORDER BY commentNo ASC
